literature.headline_zh: 人偏肺病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期人偏肺病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 从325份样本中获得了完整的基因组。研究显示A2.2.2进化枝在美国持续占主导地位,且美国内部缺乏明显的地理结构。基因组多样性在糖蛋白(G)基因中最高,观察到从携带180nt重复变异到携带111nt重复变异的转变。系统发育分析支持重复-删除模型作为重复变异起源的机制。保守的融合(F)蛋白表现出有限的抗原变异和较低的非同义替换率。 [10.1093/infdis/jiag249]
与RSV感染患儿相比,hMPV感染患儿年龄显著更大,且更常伴有基础合并症。支气管炎、咳嗽、鼻塞、呼吸急促、胸骨凹陷、啰音、吸氧治疗、吸入治疗、糖皮质激素使用以及住院情况在RSV感染患儿中更为常见(所有p < 0.05)。 [10.1007/s00431-026-07393-5]
这些因素导致了公众反应的分歧,一些人表现出焦虑,而另一些人则对病毒表现出漠视态度。 [10.1371/journal.pone.0351265]
最终的疫苗结构包含24个选定的表位(8个CTL表位、8个HTL表位和8个B细胞表位),并表现出良好的预测抗原性、稳定性、亲水性、热稳定性以及非致敏性和非毒性特性。 [10.3389/fviro.2026.1949694]

M 蛋白表达的减少导致其水平呈剂量依赖性下降,其中在感染后 1 小时(hpi)使用 10 μM PPMO M 治疗,感染后 24 小时(hpi)时 M 蛋白水平下降超过 95%。这种减少对病毒产量和滴度产生了显著影响,表现为感染后 12 和 24 小时每细胞的包含体(IB)数量增加,而每细胞的平均 IB 体积减少。此外,磷蛋白(P)在细胞膜上的表达也减少,但 vRNP 的移动未受影响。 [10.1128/jvi.01066-26]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: Complete genomes were obtained from 325 specimens. The study revealed the continued predominance of the A2.2.2 clade and little geographic structure in the United States. Genomic diversity was highest in the glycoprotein (G) gene, with a shift from variants bearing the 180nt duplication to ones with a 111nt duplication. [10.1093/infdis/jiag249]
Children with hMPV infection were significantly older and more frequently had underlying comorbidities than those with RSV infection. [10.1007/s00431-026-07393-5]
These factors have led to mixed public reactions, with some individuals expressing anxiety while others exhibit carelessness regarding the virus. [10.1371/journal.pone.0351265]

The final vaccine constructs contained 24 selected epitopes (8 CTL, 8 HTL, and 8 B-cell epitopes) and demonstrated favorable predicted antigenicity, stability, hydrophilicity, thermostability, and non-allergenic and non-toxic properties. [10.3389/fviro.2026.1949694]

Reductions in M protein expression led to dose-dependent decreases in M protein levels, with a 10 μM PPMO M treatment at 1 hour post-infection (hpi) resulting in a >95% reduction in M protein at 24 hpi. [10.1128/jvi.01066-26]

papers.title: Clinical characteristics and outcomes of respiratory syncytial virus and human metapneumovirus ınfections in children under five years of age
papers.abstract: UNLABELLED: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) and human metapneumovirus (hMPV) are major causes of acute respiratory tract infections in young children and share many epidemiological and clinical characteristics. This study aimed to compare the clinical characteristics, outcomes, and healthcare costs associated with RSV and hMPV infections in children younger than five years of age. In this retrospective comparative cohort study, children aged 1-71 months with laboratory-confirmed RSV or hMPV infection identified by multiplex real-time polymerase chain reaction were included. RSV cases identified between September 2022 and April 2023 and hMPV cases identified between September 2022 and December 2025 were included. Both outpatient and hospitalized patients evaluated at a tertiary pediatric hospital were enrolled. A total of 693 children were included, comprising 547 with RSV infection and 146 with hMPV infection. Children with hMPV infection were significantly older and more frequently had underlying comorbidities than those with RSV infection. Bronchiolitis, cough, nasal congestion, tachypnea, chest retractions, rhonchi, oxygen supplementation, inhaled therapies, corticosteroid use, and hospitalization were more common among children with RSV infection (all p 0.05). CONCLUSION: Consistent with previous studies, RSV and hMPV differed in age distribution, clinical presentation, and healthcare utilization. These data provide additional evidence from a tertiary pediatric center in Türkiye and support the generalizability of these observations across different geographic settings. WHAT IS KNOWN: • RSV and hMPV are major causes of acute respiratory tract infections in young children, but direct comparisons between these viruses remain limited. WHAT IS NEW: • In this large pediatric cohort, RSV predominantly affected younger children and was associated with more bronchiolitis, hospitalization, and supportive treatment needs, whereas hMPV was more common in older children with comorbidities and was more frequently associated with pneumonia.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究是一项在三级儿科医院进行的回顾性比较队列研究研究,纳入了1-71个月龄、通过多重实时聚合酶链反应(PCR)确诊的RSV或hMPV感染患儿。RSV病例的收集时间为2022年9月至2023年4月,而hMPV病例的收集时间为2022年9月至2025年12月。纳入了门诊和住院患儿。

elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于其回顾性设计和单中心数据,这可能影响其结果的普遍适用性。然而,这些数据来自土耳其一家三级儿科中心,支持了这些观察结果在不同地理环境中的普遍适用性。

papers.title: Genomic Surveillance of Human Metapneumovirus in the United States, 2010-2025.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Human metapneumovirus (HMPV) is a significant cause of acute respiratory illness in both children and adults, yet its genomic epidemiology remains understudied compared to other respiratory viruses. METHODS: Hybrid capture and whole-genome sequencing were performed on 616 HMPV-positive specimens from 2 cohorts: the household-based HIVE study (2010-2022) in Michigan and the multicenter IVY network (2022-2025) of hospitalized adults. Consensus sequences were generated using IRMA, clades were annotated using Nextclade, and phylogenetic trees were constructed separately for HMPV-A and HMPV-B using IQ-TREE and TreeTime. Analysis of selection by dN/dS was performed using SLAC. RESULTS: We obtained complete genomes from 325 specimens. Our analyses revealed the continued predominance of the A2.2.2 clade and little geographic structure in the United States. Genomic diversity was highest in the glycoprotein (G); we identified a shift from variants bearing the 180nt duplication to ones with a 111nt duplication. Phylogenetic analyses supported the duplication-deletion model for the origin of the duplications. The conserved fusion (F) protein showed limited antigenic variation and low rates of nonsynonymous substitutions. CONCLUSIONS: These findings underscore the utility of enhanced genomic surveillance for understanding HMPV evolution and informing vaccine development. There was little genomic diversity in vaccine-targeted epitopes.
authors: Investigating Respiratory Viruses in the Acutely Ill (IVY) Network

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在了解美国人偏肺病毒(人偏肺病毒,HMPV)的基因组流行病学,以应对这一研究不足的呼吸道病毒的增强监测需求。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究涉及两个队列研究中HMPV阳性样本的基因组监测:密歇根州基于家庭的HIVE研究(2010-2022)和2022-2025年多中心IVY网络(住院成人),共计616份样本。
elements_zh.methods: 对样本进行了混合捕获和全基因组测序。使用IRMA生成共识序列,使用Nextclade标注进化枝,并使用IQ-TREE和TreeTime分别构建HMPV-A和HMPV-B的系统发育树。使用SLAC进行选择分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 从325份样本中获得了完整的基因组。研究显示A2.2.2进化枝在美国持续占主导地位,且美国内部缺乏明显的地理结构。基因组多样性在糖蛋白(G)基因中最高,观察到从携带180nt重复变异到携带111nt重复变异的转变。系统发育分析支持重复-删除模型作为重复变异起源的机制。保守的融合(F)蛋白表现出有限的抗原变异和较低的非同义替换率。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现强调了增强的基因组监测在理解HMPV 进化和指导疫苗开发中的重要性。在疫苗靶向的表位中,基因组多样性较低。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果可用于指导HMPV感染的监测、诊断和治疗,以及未来疫苗的开发。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究受限于对基因组监测的依赖以及缺乏详细的临床数据。研究结果表明证据强度中等。

Consensus sequences were generated using IRMA, clades were annotated using Nextclade, and phylogenetic trees were constructed separately for HMPV-A and HMPV-B using IQ-TREE and TreeTime. Analysis of selection by dN/dS was performed using SLAC. RESULTS: We obtained complete genomes from 325 specimens. Our analyses revealed the continued predominance of the A2.2.2 clade and little geographic structure in the United States. Genomic diversity was highest in the glycoprotein (G); we identified a shift from variants bearing the 180nt duplication to ones with a 111nt duplication. Phylogenetic analyses supported the duplication-deletion model for the origin of the duplications. The conserved fusion (F) protein showed limited antigenic variation and low rates of nonsynonymous substitutions. CONCLUSIONS: These findings underscore the utility of enhanced genomic surveillance for understanding HMPV evolution and informing vaccine development. There was little genomic diversity in vaccine-targeted epitopes.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在了解美国人偏肺病毒(人偏肺病毒,HMPV)的基因组流行病学,以应对这一研究不足的呼吸道病毒的增强监测需求。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究涉及两个队列研究中HMPV阳性样本的基因组监测:密歇根州基于家庭的HIVE研究(2010-2022)和2022-2025年多中心IVY网络(住院成人),共计616份样本。
analysis_zh.methods: 对样本进行了混合捕获和全基因组测序。使用IRMA生成共识序列,使用Nextclade标注进化枝,并使用IQ-TREE和TreeTime分别构建HMPV-A和HMPV-B的系统发育树。使用SLAC进行选择分析。
analysis_zh.main_results: 从325份样本中获得了完整的基因组。研究显示A2.2.2进化枝在美国持续占主导地位,且美国内部缺乏明显的地理结构。基因组多样性在糖蛋白(G)基因中最高,观察到从携带180nt重复变异到携带111nt重复变异的转变。系统发育分析支持重复-删除模型作为重复变异起源的机制。保守的融合(F)蛋白表现出有限的抗原变异和较低的非同义替换率。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现强调了增强的基因组监测在理解HMPV 进化和指导疫苗开发中的重要性。在疫苗靶向的表位中,基因组多样性较低。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果可用于指导HMPV感染的监测、诊断和治疗,以及未来疫苗的开发。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究受限于对基因组监测的依赖以及缺乏详细的临床数据。研究结果表明证据强度中等。

papers.title: Explainable AI for sentiment analysis of human metapneumovirus (HMPV) using XLNet
papers.abstract: The outbreak of Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) in China, which later spread to the UK and other countries, raised significant public concern due to its potential impact on vulnerable populations. While HMPV typically causes mild symptoms, its effects on the elderly and immunocompromised individuals prompted health authorities to emphasize preventive measures. Moreover, continuous monitoring of respiratory viruses like HMPV remains important, as new factors (such as emerging variants) could alter their behavior over time. These factors have led to mixed public reactions, with some individuals expressing anxiety while others exhibit carelessness regarding the virus. This paper explores how sentiment analysis can enhance our understanding of public reactions to HMPV by analyzing data from social media platforms like YouTube. It highlights the importance of tracking public sentiment-ranging from fear to trust-to guide health messaging, inform policies, address misinformation, and encourage compliance with preventive measures during outbreaks. This study focuses on the use of sentiment analysis to understand public reactions to HMPV during the 2024 outbreak. The research applies advanced transformer models, particularly XLNet, achieving an accuracy of 93.50% in sentiment classification tasks. Additionally, We incorporate explainable AI (XAI) through SHAP to provide transparency in how the model identifies key factors influencing public sentiment.

The research applies advanced transformer models, particularly XLNet, achieving an accuracy of 93.50% in sentiment classification tasks. Additionally, We incorporate explainable AI (XAI) through SHAP to provide transparency in how the model identifies key factors influencing public sentiment.

papers.title: Bivalent RSVpreF Effectiveness Against Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV)-Related Respiratory Disease Hospitalization and Emergency Department Visits Across Three RSV Seasons
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) protein subunit vaccines reduce the risk of severe outcomes such as hospitalization and emergency department (ED) visits for at least two RSV seasons following vaccination. No data have been published on real-world RSV vaccine effectiveness (VE) beyond the second season after vaccination. This study evaluates bivalent RSVpreF VE against RSV-related respiratory disease hospitalizations/ED visits throughout three seasons after vaccination. METHODS: This retrospective test-negative case-control study evaluates bivalent RSVpreF VE among adults aged ≥60 years at Kaiser Permanente Southern California, USA, with lower respiratory tract disease (LRTD) or acute respiratory illness (ARI) over three RSV seasons (11/24/2023-4/18/2026). Cases were RSV-positive without coinfection. Controls were negative for RSV, hMPV, influenza, SARS-CoV-2, and positive for a non-vaccine preventable disease pathogen. Exposure was bivalent RSVpreF (Abrysvo) receipt ≥ 21 days before LRTD/ARI. Adjusted VE was estimated using odds ratios from multivariable logistic regression or generalized estimating equations. RESULTS: Overall adjusted VE against RSV-related LRTD hospitalization/ED visits was 80% (95% CI 68-87), 70% (95% CI 53-81), and 51% (95% CI -12-78) in the first, second, and third season after vaccination, respectively. Overall adjusted VE against RSV-related ARI hospitalization/ED visits was 81% (71-87), 64% (48-75), and 60% (15-81), respectively. Adjusted VE among non-immunocompromised individuals trended 4-7% higher than corresponding overall estimates. Overall adjusted VE across the three combined seasons was 73% (95% CI 64-80) and 73% (95% CI 65-79) against RSV-related LRTD and ARI, respectively. CONCLUSION: Bivalent RSVpreF provides protection against RSV-related respiratory hospitalization/ED visits for at least three seasons after vaccination in this population of older adults with a high prevalence of comorbidities. Estimates in the third season for ARI were more definitive, while those for LRTD were imprecise due to limited event numbers. This suggests bivalent RSVpreF vaccination results in substantial individual and public health benefit. TRIAL REGISTRATION: ClinicalTrials.gov ID: NCT06077968.

papers.title_zh: 双价RSVpreF对呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)相关呼吸道疾病住院和急诊科就诊的保护效果:跨越三个RSV季节的分析
papers.source_body_en: INTRODUCTION: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) protein subunit vaccines reduce the risk of severe outcomes such as hospitalization and emergency department (ED) visits for at least two RSV seasons following vaccination. No data have been published on real-world RSV vaccine effectiveness (VE) beyond the second season after vaccination. This study evaluates bivalent RSVpreF VE against RSV-related respiratory disease hospitalizations/ED visits throughout three seasons after vaccination. METHODS: This retrospective test-negative case-control study evaluates bivalent RSVpreF VE among adults aged ≥60 years at Kaiser Permanente Southern California, USA, with lower respiratory tract disease (LRTD) or acute respiratory illness (ARI) over three RSV seasons (11/24/2023-4/18/2026). Cases were RSV-positive without coinfection. Controls were negative for RSV, hMPV, influenza, SARS-CoV-2, and positive for a non-vaccine preventable disease pathogen. Exposure was bivalent RSVpreF (Abrysvo) receipt ≥ 21 days before LRTD/ARI. Adjusted VE was estimated using odds ratios from multivariable logistic regression or generalized estimating equations. RESULTS: Overall adjusted VE against RSV-related LRTD hospitalization/ED visits was 80% (95% CI 68-87), 70% (95% CI 53-81), and 51% (95% CI -12-78) in the first, second, and third season after vaccination, respectively. Overall adjusted VE against RSV-related ARI hospitalization/ED visits was 81% (71-87), 64% (48-75), and 60% (15-81), respectively. Adjusted VE among non-immunocompromised individuals trended 4-7% higher than corresponding overall estimates. Overall adjusted VE across the three combined seasons was 73% (95% CI 64-80) and 73% (95% CI 65-79) against RSV-related LRTD and ARI, respectively. CONCLUSION: Bivalent RSVpreF provides protection against RSV-related respiratory hospitalization/ED visits for at least three seasons after vaccination in this population of older adults with a high prevalence of comorbidities. Estimates in the third season for ARI were more definitive, while those for LRTD were imprecise due to limited event numbers. This suggests bivalent RSVpreF vaccination results in substantial individual and public health benefit. TRIAL REGISTRATION: ClinicalTrials.gov ID: NCT06077968.
papers.abstract_zh: INTRODUCTION: 呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)蛋白亚单位疫苗在至少两个RSV季节后可降低住院和急诊科(ED)就诊等严重结果的风险。目前尚未有关于RSV 疫苗在第二个RSV季节之后的真实世界有效性(VE)的数据。本研究评估了双价RSVpreF在三个RSV季节(2023年11月24日-2026年4月18日)内对RSV相关呼吸道疾病住院和急诊科就诊的有效性。METHODS: 本研究是一项回顾性测试阴性病例对照研究,评估了美国 Kaiser Permanente Southern California 区域内≥60岁成人中双价RSVpreF的有效性(VE),这些人在三个RSV季节内患有下呼吸道疾病(LRTD)或急性呼吸道疾病(ARI)。病例为RSV阳性且无合并感染,对照组为RSV、hMPV、流感、SARS-CoV-2阴性,但对非疫苗可预防的疾病病原体阳性。暴露为在LRTD/ARI发生前至少21天接种双价RSVpreF(Abrysvo)。使用多变量逻辑回归或广义估计方程的比值比(OR)估计调整后的有效性(VE)。RESULTS: 在疫苗接种后第一、第二和第三RSV季节中,针对RSV相关LRTD住院/急诊科就诊的调整后VE分别为80%(95% CI 68-87)、70%(95% CI 53-81)和51%(95% CI -12-78)。针对RSV相关ARI住院/急诊科就诊的调整后VE分别为81%(71-87)、64%(48-75)和60%(15-81)。非免疫缺陷个体的调整后VE比总体估计高出4-7%。三个季节合并后的调整后VE分别为73%(95% CI 64-80)和73%(95% CI 65-79)针对RSV相关LRTD和ARI。CONCLUSION: 在具有高患病率合并症的老年人群中,双价RSVpreF在疫苗接种后至少三个RSV季节内提供了对RSV相关呼吸道住院/急诊科就诊的保护。第三季ARI的估计更为明确,而LRTD的估计因事件数量有限而不够精确。这表明双价RSVpreF 疫苗接种在个体和公共卫生层面带来了显著的益处。TRIAL REGISTRATION: ClinicalTrials.gov ID: NCT06077968.

papers.title: Computational designing of multiepitope based vaccine (MEBV) candidate against human metapneumovirus (HMPV) using immunoinformatics approach
papers.abstract: Abstract Human metapneumovirus (HMPV) is a paramyxoviridae family respiratory pathogen, which is closely related to respiratory syncytial virus. It produces the symptoms of the flu and it may result in the serious damage of the airways and even though it is a worldwide problem, there is no vaccine available as yet. Three antigenic proteins namely surface glycoprotein, nucleoprotein and phosphoprotein were screened from all the receptors and showed no similarity to host genome. The three viral proteins were then screened for identifying the cytotoxic and helper T cell lymphocytes as well as linear and conformational B-cell lymphocytes. The vaccine had 13 MHC-I epitopes, one MHC-II epitope, and four linear B-cell epitopes, which were combined with linkers and beta-defensin as adjuvant into a 296-amino-acid MEBV with antigenicity score of 0.6644. Molecular docking and MD simulations showed that there is a high degree of interaction with human TLR3 with binding energy of − 14.6 and immune activation. Moreover, the disulfide engineering enhanced construct stability. Cloning and codon optimization was used to verify efficient expression in the target host. Taken together, these findings suggest that the proposed MEBV has potential as an immunogen of HMPV.

papers.title: Human metapneumovirus in central China, 2024–2025: epidemiology, co-infections, and temporal dynamics
papers.abstract: Human metapneumovirus (HMPV) is a major cause of acute respiratory infections in children, but comprehensive data from sentinel surveillance in the post‐pandemic period remain limited. Understanding its epidemiology and co‐infection patterns is critical for surveillance and prevention. We analyzed 36,143 respiratory specimens from ILI/SARI patients in Henan, China (2024–2025) using multiplex PCR for HMPV and 14 other pathogens. Positivity rates, enrichment ratios, co‐infection patterns, pathogen associations (OR/PR), and temporal dynamics (cross‐correlation and regression) were assessed. Overall HMPV positivity was 3.96% (1,432/36,143), with a sharp inter-year difference: 7.1% in 2024 vs. 1.7% in 2025, peaking at 26.2% during week 48. Children aged 3–5 years had the highest positivity (8.6%; enrichment ratio 2.18). Co-infections occurred in 56.2% of HMPV-positive cases, predominantly with Streptococcus pneumoniae and Haemophilus influenzae. HMPV showed positive associations with these bacteria (OR = 2.01 and 1.47, respectively) but negative associations with influenza virus (OR = 0.20) and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) (OR = 0.17). HBoV also showed a positive association (OR = 1.66). RSV positivity at a 1-week lag had a positive effect on HMPV (β = 0.15, P = 0.048). HMPV was frequently detected in pediatric ILI/SARI patients during 2024–2025, with high rates of bacterial co‐detection. The temporal lead‐lag relationship with RSV underscores the need for integrated surveillance and age‐targeted prevention. The marked 2024 resurgence warrants continued monitoring to determine whether the observed patterns represent a short‐term anomaly or a sustained change in HMPV circulation.

Understanding its epidemiology and co‐infection patterns is critical for surveillance and prevention.
analysis.study_design_and_population: We analyzed 36,143 respiratory specimens from ILI/SARI patients in Henan, China (2024–2025) using multiplex PCR for HMPV and 14 other pathogens. Overall HMPV positivity was 3.96% (1,432/36,143), with a sharp inter-year difference: 7.1% in 2024 vs. 1.7% in 2025, peaking at 26.2% during week 48.
analysis.methods: Positivity rates, enrichment ratios, co‐infection patterns, pathogen associations (OR/PR), and temporal dynamics (cross‐correlation and regression) were assessed. Children aged 3–5 years had the highest positivity (8.6%; enrichment ratio 2.18).
analysis.main_results: HMPV showed positive associations with Streptococcus pneumoniae (OR = 2.01) and Haemophilus influenzae (OR = 1.47), but negative associations with influenza virus (OR = 0.20) and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) (OR = 0.17). RSV positivity at a 1-week lag had a positive effect on HMPV (β = 0.15, P = 0.048).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The temporal lead‐lag relationship with RSV underscores the need for integrated surveillance and age‐targeted prevention. analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings highlight the importance of integrated surveillance systems to monitor HMPV and its co-infections, particularly with bacterial pathogens, and suggest the need for age-specific prevention strategies. The study also emphasizes the necessity of continued monitoring to understand long-term trends in HMPV circulation.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on sentinel surveillance data from a single geographic region, which may affect generalisability. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the observational nature of the study and potential confounding factors.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the epidemiology, co-infections, and temporal dynamics of human metapneumovirus (HMPV) in Henan, China, during 2024–2025. It reports that HMPV positivity was 3.96% overall, with a notable resurgence in 2024. The virus showed positive associations with Streptococcus pneumoniae and Haemophilus influenzae, but negative associations with influenza virus and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV). RSV positivity at a 1-week lag had a positive effect on HMPV. The study highlights the need for integrated surveillance and age-targeted prevention strategies, as well as continued monitoring to determine whether the observed patterns represent a short-term anomaly or a sustained change in HMPV circulation. The findings are of moderate strength due to the observational design and potential confounding factors.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 人偏肺病毒(人偏肺病毒,HMPV)是儿童急性呼吸道感染的主要原因之一,但疫情后哨点监测的综合数据仍较为有限。了解其流行病学及共感染模式对于监测和预防至关重要。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们使用多重PCR方法分析了2024–2025年中国河南省ILI/SARI患者的36,143份呼吸道样本,检测HMPV及14种其他病原体。总体HMPV阳性率为3.96%(1,432/36,143),且年度间差异显著:2024年为7.1%,2025年为1.7%,在第48周达到峰值26.2%。
elements_zh.methods: 评估了阳性率、富集比、共感染模式、病原体关联性(OR/PR)以及时间动态(交叉相关性和回归分析)。3–5岁儿童的阳性率最高(8.6%;富集比2.18)。

papers.title_zh: 中国中部人偏肺病毒疫情,2024–2025年:流行病学、共感染及时间动态
papers.source_body_en: Human metapneumovirus (HMPV) is a major cause of acute respiratory infections in children, but comprehensive data from sentinel surveillance in the post‐pandemic period remain limited. Understanding its epidemiology and co‐infection patterns is critical for surveillance and prevention. We analyzed 36,143 respiratory specimens from ILI/SARI patients in Henan, China (2024–2025) using multiplex PCR for HMPV and 14 other pathogens. Positivity rates, enrichment ratios, co‐infection patterns, pathogen associations (OR/PR), and temporal dynamics (cross‐correlation and regression) were assessed. Overall HMPV positivity was 3.96% (1,432/36,143), with a sharp inter-year difference: 7.1% in 2024 vs. 1.7% in 2025, peaking at 26.2% during week 48. Children aged 3–5 years had the highest positivity (8.6%; enrichment ratio 2.18). Co-infections occurred in 56.2% of HMPV-positive cases, predominantly with Streptococcus pneumoniae and Haemophilus influenzae. HMPV showed positive associations with these bacteria (OR = 2.01 and 1.47, respectively) but negative associations with influenza virus (OR = 0.20) and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) (OR = 0.17). HBoV also showed a positive association (OR = 1.66). RSV positivity at a 1-week lag had a positive effect on HMPV (β = 0.15, P = 0.048). HMPV was frequently detected in pediatric ILI/SARI patients during 2024–2025, with high rates of bacterial co‐detection. The temporal lead‐lag relationship with RSV underscores the need for integrated surveillance and age‐targeted prevention. The marked 2024 resurgence warrants continued monitoring to determine whether the observed patterns represent a short‐term anomaly or a sustained change in HMPV circulation.
papers.abstract_zh: 人偏肺病毒(人偏肺病毒,HMPV)是儿童急性呼吸道感染的主要原因之一,但疫情后哨点监测的综合数据仍较为有限。了解其流行病学及共感染模式对于监测和预防至关重要。我们使用多重PCR方法分析了2024–2025年中国河南省ILI/SARI患者的36,143份呼吸道样本,检测HMPV及14种其他病原体。评估了阳性率、富集比、共感染模式、病原体关联性(OR/PR)以及时间动态(交叉相关性和回归分析)。总体HMPV阳性率为3.96%(1,432/36,143),且年度间差异显著:2024年为7.1%,2025年为1.7%,在第48周达到峰值26.2%。3–5岁儿童的阳性率最高(8.6%;富集比2.18)。HMPV阳性病例中,共感染发生率为56.2%,主要与肺炎链球菌和流感嗜血杆菌共感染。HMPV与这两种细菌呈正相关(OR分别为2.01和1.47),但与流感病毒(OR = 0.20)和呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)呈负相关(OR = 0.17)。HMPV还与人类博卡病毒(HBoV)呈正相关(OR = 1.66)。RSV阳性在1周滞后时对HMPV呈正向影响(β = 0.15,P = 0.048)。2024–2025年期间,HMPV在儿科ILI/SARI患者中频繁检出,且细菌共感染率较高。与RSV的时间领先-滞后关系强调了需要整合监测监测和针对年龄的预防措施。2024年的显著回升需要持续监测,以确定所观察到的模式是短期异常还是HMPV传播的持续变化。

papers.title: Reduced expression of human metapneumovirus matrix protein impacts virus assembly and ribonucleoprotein localization
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Human metapneumovirus (HMPV) causes severe respiratory tract infections in all cohorts, particularly in vulnerable groups such as children, older adults, and the immunocompromised. The matrix (M) protein of HMPV, like the M proteins of other members of the order Mononegavirales , is involved in virus assembly and budding. However, other functions of the HMPV M protein have yet to be elucidated. To investigate the various functions of the M protein, we used a peptide-conjugated phosphorodiamidate morpholino oligomer (PPMO) antisense agent designed to block translation of the M gene during infection. Treatment with the PPMO targeted against M mRNA (PPMO M ) led to dose-dependent decreases in M expression, and a 10 μM PPMO M treatment applied at 1 hour post-infection (hpi) led to a >95% reduction in M protein at 24 hpi. Reductions in M expression had a significant impact on virus production and viral titers. Fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH) probes used to detect vRNA showed that a reduction in M led to an increase in inclusion body (IB) count per cell, but a decrease in the average IB volume per cell at 12 and 24 hpi. HMPV-infected cells treated with PPMO M exhibited lower levels of phosphoprotein (P) at the plasma membrane. Importantly, no change in viral ribonucleoprotein movement (vRNP) was observed when the M protein levels were reduced. These studies support a model where the M protein does not facilitate movement, but instead is critical for the transfer to and stable association of vRNPs with the assembly sites at the membrane. IMPORTANCE Human metapneumovirus (HMPV) is a respiratory pathogen that can cause severe infections in humans, but there are no targeted treatment options for HMPV. To better characterize HMPV, a matrix (M) protein-targeted peptide-conjugated phosphorodiamidate morpholino oligomer (PPMO M ) was designed to control M expression during infection. Inhibition of M expression resulted in infections with reduced viral filaments and less viral RNA at the cell periphery. A reduction in M protein expression did not disrupt the active transport of viral ribonucleoproteins (vRNPs) but did significantly decrease vRNP localization at membranes and increase the number of inclusion bodies within infected cells. Viral titers were significantly reduced when M protein expression was inhibited, and dose-dependent reductions in M protein directly correlated with viral particle production. This study uses a unique tool to characterize the HMPV M protein during infection.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the various functions of the matrix (M) protein of human metapneumovirus (HMPV) to better understand its role in virus assembly and budding, given that other functions of the HMPV M protein have yet to be elucidated.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study used a peptide-conjugated phosphorodiamidate morpholino oligomer (PPMO) antisense agent designed to block translation of the M gene during HMPV infection in cells.
analysis.methods: The researchers used a PPMO M to target and reduce M protein expression, and then analyzed the effects on virus production, viral titers, and viral ribonucleoprotein (vRNP) localization using techniques such as fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH).
analysis.main_results: Reductions in M protein expression led to dose-dependent decreases in M protein levels, with a 10 μM PPMO M treatment at 1 hour post-infection (hpi) resulting in a >95% reduction in M protein at 24 hpi. This reduction had a significant impact on virus production and titers, with increased inclusion body (IB) count per cell and decreased average IB volume per cell at 12 and 24 hpi. Additionally, there was a decrease in phosphoprotein (P) at the plasma membrane, but no change in vRNP movement.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study supports a model where the M protein is critical for the transfer to and stable association of vRNPs with the assembly sites at the membrane, rather than facilitating movement, and highlights the importance of M protein in virus assembly and budding.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that targeting the M protein could be a potential therapeutic approach for HMPV, as it significantly impacts virus production and titers, which could inform future treatment strategies for HMPV infections.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by the use of a cell culture model, which may not fully represent the complexity of in vivo infections. The evidence strength is moderate due to the reliance on a single model system.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the role of the matrix (M) protein in human metapneumovirus (HMPV) assembly and budding by using a PPMO M to reduce M protein expression. The results showed that M protein is critical for vRNP localization at the membrane and significantly impacts virus production, suggesting potential therapeutic targets.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨 人偏肺病毒(人偏肺病毒)矩阵(M)蛋白的多种功能,以更好地理解其在病毒组装和出芽中的作用,鉴于人偏肺病毒 M 蛋白的其他功能尚未阐明。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究使用了一种肽偶联的磷酸二酯酶形态啉寡核苷酸(PPMO)反义药物,设计用于在人偏肺病毒感染细胞期间阻断 M 基因的翻译。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员使用 PPMO M 靶向并减少 M 蛋白的表达,随后利用荧光原位杂交(FISH)等技术分析其对病毒产量、病毒滴度和病毒核糖核蛋白(vRNP)定位的影响。
elements_zh.main_results: M 蛋白表达的减少导致其水平呈剂量依赖性下降,其中在感染后 1 小时(hpi)使用 10 μM PPMO M 治疗,感染后 24 小时(hpi)时 M 蛋白水平下降超过 95%。这种减少对病毒产量和滴度产生了显著影响,表现为感染后 12 和 24 小时每细胞的包含体(IB)数量增加,而每细胞的平均 IB 体积减少。此外,磷蛋白(P)在细胞膜上的表达也减少,但 vRNP 的移动未受影响。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究支持一种模型,即 M 蛋白在将 vRNP 转移到膜组装位点并使其稳定结合方面起关键作用,而不是促进其移动,并强调了 M 蛋白在病毒组装和出芽中的重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,靶向 M 蛋白可能是治疗人偏肺病毒的一种潜在方法,因为其显著影响病毒产量和滴度,这可能为未来针对人偏肺病毒感染的 治疗 策略提供依据。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于使用了细胞培养模型,这可能无法完全反映体内感染的复杂性。由于依赖单一模型系统,证据强度中等。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 人偏肺病毒 (HMPV) 在所有 队列研究 中引起严重呼吸道感染,特别是在儿童、老年人和免疫功能低下等弱势群体中。HMPV 的基质 (M) 蛋白与单链病毒目其他成员的 M 蛋白一样,参与病毒组装和出芽。然而,HMPV M 蛋白的其他功能尚未阐明。为了研究 M 蛋白的各种功能,我们使用了肽缀合的磷酸二酰胺吗啉寡聚物 (PPMO) 反义剂,旨在阻断感染期间 M 基因的翻译。治疗 与针对 M mRNA (PPMO M ) 的 PPMO 导致 M 表达呈剂量依赖性下降,感染后 1 小时 (hpi) 应用 10 μM PPMO M 治疗 导致 24 hpi 时 M 蛋白减少 > 95%。M 表达的减少对病毒产生和病毒滴度有显着影响。用于检测 vRNA 的荧光原位杂交 (FISH) 探针显示,M 的减少导致每个细胞的包涵体 (IB) 计数增加,但在 12 和 24 hpi 时每个细胞的平均 IB 体积减少。用 PPMO M 处理的 HMPV 感染细胞在质膜上表现出较低水平的磷蛋白 (P)。重要的是,当 M 蛋白水平降低时,没有观察到病毒核糖核蛋白运动 (vRNP) 的变化。这些研究支持这样一种模型:M 蛋白并不促进运动,而是对于 vRNP 转移到膜上的组装位点并与膜上的组装位点稳定结合至关重要。重要性 人偏肺病毒 (HMPV) 是一种呼吸道病原体,可引起人类严重感染,但没有针对 HMPV 的针对性 治疗 选择。为了更好地表征 HMPV,设计了一种基质 (M) 蛋白靶向肽缀合的磷酸二酰胺吗啉寡聚物 (PPMO M ) 来控制感染期间的 M 表达。抑制 M 表达会导致感染时细胞外周病毒丝减少,病毒 RNA 减少。M蛋白表达的减少不会破坏病毒核糖核蛋白(vRNP)的主动运输,但会显着降低vRNP在膜上的定位并增加感染细胞内包涵体的数量。当 M 蛋白表达受到抑制时,病毒滴度显着降低,并且 M 蛋白的剂量依赖性降低与病毒颗粒的产生直接相关。本研究使用独特的工具来表征感染期间的 HMPV M 蛋白。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨 人偏肺病毒(人偏肺病毒)矩阵(M)蛋白的多种功能,以更好地理解其在病毒组装和出芽中的作用,鉴于人偏肺病毒 M 蛋白的其他功能尚未阐明。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究使用了一种肽偶联的磷酸二酯酶形态啉寡核苷酸(PPMO)反义药物,设计用于在人偏肺病毒感染细胞期间阻断 M 基因的翻译。
analysis_zh.methods: 研究人员使用 PPMO M 靶向并减少 M 蛋白的表达,随后利用荧光原位杂交(FISH)等技术分析其对病毒产量、病毒滴度和病毒核糖核蛋白(vRNP)定位的影响。
analysis_zh.main_results: M 蛋白表达的减少导致其水平呈剂量依赖性下降,其中在感染后 1 小时(hpi)使用 10 μM PPMO M 治疗,感染后 24 小时(hpi)时 M 蛋白水平下降超过 95%。这种减少对病毒产量和滴度产生了显著影响,表现为感染后 12 和 24 小时每细胞的包含体(IB)数量增加,而每细胞的平均 IB 体积减少。此外,磷蛋白(P)在细胞膜上的表达也减少,但 vRNP 的移动未受影响。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究支持一种模型,即 M 蛋白在将 vRNP 转移到膜组装位点并使其稳定结合方面起关键作用,而不是促进其移动,并强调了 M 蛋白在病毒组装和出芽中的重要性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,靶向 M 蛋白可能是治疗人偏肺病毒的一种潜在方法,因为其显著影响病毒产量和滴度,这可能为未来针对人偏肺病毒感染的 治疗 策略提供依据。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于使用了细胞培养模型,这可能无法完全反映体内感染的复杂性。由于依赖单一模型系统,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Emerging Trends in the Pathogenesis, Diagnosis, and Management of Human Metapneumovirus-Associated Respiratory Infections
papers.abstract: Introduction: Human Metapneumovirus is a significant respiratory pathogen causing infections across all age groups, particularly in young children, immunocompromised individuals, and the elderly. Despite its clinical relevance, there are currently no approved vaccines or specific antiviral treatments for Human Metapneumovirus, necessitating further research into therapeutic and preventive strategies. Methods: A systematic literature review was conducted using peer-reviewed journals, clinical trials, and recent studies focusing on Human Metapneumovirus infection. Data were extracted and analyzed to evaluate the effectiveness of antiviral therapies, monoclonal antibodies, immunomodulators, and vaccine candidates. Results: Studies indicate that Human Metapneumovirus primarily targets the respiratory epithelium, triggering immune responses that contribute to both viral clearance and disease pathogenesis. Investigational therapies, including fusion inhibitors and protease inhibitors, show promise but require further validation. Immunomodulatory agents and herbal remedies may offer supportive benefits, but their efficacy against Human Metapneumovirus remains unproven. Advances in vaccine development are ongoing, with several candidates in preclinical and early clinical stages. Discussion: HMPV continues to pose a substantial public health burden due to its seasonal outbreaks, clinical similarity to other respiratory viruses, and absence of specific therapies. The virus evades immune responses via multiple mechanisms, contributing to disease severity, particularly in vulnerable populations. Although supportive care is currently the mainstay, emerging antivirals and vaccines may offer future solutions. Improved diagnostic access, public awareness, and targeted research are essential for controlling HMPV infections. Conclusion: Human Metapneumovirus continues to pose a public health challenge due to the lack of targeted treatments and vaccines. Ongoing research into antiviral agents, monoclonal antibodies, and vaccines is critical for effective disease management. Further clinical trials are needed to establish safe and effective therapeutic options.

The evidence base includes a systematic literature review of peer-reviewed journals, clinical trials, and recent studies. Controversies include the unproven efficacy of immunomodulatory agents and herbal remedies, and the necessity for more clinical trials to establish safe and effective therapeutic options. Research and practice implications emphasize the importance of continued investigation into antiviral agents, monoclonal antibodies, and vaccines to address the public health challenge posed by HMPV.

papers.abstract_zh: 引言:人偏肺病毒(HMPV)是一种重要的呼吸道病原体,可在不同年龄段人群中引发感染,尤其是在幼儿、免疫功能低下者及老年人中。尽管其具有重要的临床意义,但目前尚无获批的抗病毒药物或针对人偏肺病毒的特异性治疗方法,亟需进一步研究治疗和预防策略。方法:通过系统性文献综述,检索同行评议期刊、临床试验及近期研究,重点关注人偏肺病毒感染。提取并分析数据,以评估抗病毒药物、单克隆抗体、免疫调节剂及疫苗候选物的有效性。结果:研究表明,人偏肺病毒主要靶向呼吸道上皮细胞,触发免疫应答,这些免疫应答既有助于病毒清除,也会导致疾病发病机制。正在研发的治疗方法,包括融合抑制剂和蛋白酶抑制剂,显示出潜力,但仍需进一步验证。免疫调节剂和中草药可能提供支持性益处,但其对人偏肺病毒的有效性尚未得到证实。疫苗研发取得进展,多个候选疫苗已进入临床前及早期临床阶段。讨论:由于人偏肺病毒的季节性流行、与其他呼吸道病毒的临床相似性以及缺乏特异性治疗方法,该病毒继续对公共卫生构成重大负担。该病毒通过多种机制逃避免疫应答,导致疾病严重程度增加,尤其是在易感人群中。尽管目前主要采用支持性治疗,但新兴的抗病毒药物和疫苗可能为未来提供解决方案。改善诊断可及性、提高公众意识及开展针对性研究对于控制人偏肺病毒感染至关重要。结论:由于缺乏针对性治疗方法和疫苗,人偏肺病毒继续对公共卫生构成挑战。针对抗病毒药物、单克隆抗体及疫苗的持续研究对于有效疾病管理至关重要。亟需进一步临床试验以确立安全有效的治疗方案。

papers.title: Age-stratified clinical features and factors associated with severe pneumonia in hospitalized children with human metapneumovirus–associated lower respiratory tract infection
papers.abstract: Human metapneumovirus (hMPV) is a major cause of lower respiratory tract infection (LRTI) in children, yet age-stratified analyses across the full pediatric age range and the associations between pathogen co-detection and disease severity remain incompletely characterized. We aimed to delineate the age-related clinical features of hMPV-LRTI and identify factors associated with severe pneumonia. This retrospective study included children aged 0 to 6 years had the highest proportions of atelectasis (22.4%), unilateral involvement (65.7%), and severe pneumonia (31.0%). In the primary model, atelectasis (adjusted odds ratio [aOR] = 47.52), underlying disease (9.49), consolidation (6.82), fever (3.29), wheezing (2.50), Mycoplasma pneumoniae (MP) co-detection (1.90), higher absolute neutrophil counts (1.47 per 5 × 109/L), and higher C-reactive protein levels (1.14 per 10 mg/L) were associated with higher odds; higher absolute monocyte counts (0.71 per 1 × 109/L) and bacterial co-detection (0.60) were associated with lower odds. The large radiological associations may partly reflect overlap with the extent-based severity criteria. MP co-detection increased from 6.0% in infants aged 0–6 months to 50.0% in children > 6 years. The overall age-group term did not reach statistical significance. Clinical and radiological manifestations of hMPV-LRTI varied across age groups. MP co-detection was more frequent in older children and was associated with higher odds of severe pneumonia after multivariable adjustment. These findings may inform age-specific clinical assessment, with attention to respiratory status in young infants and, in school-aged children, peri-admission chest imaging when clinically indicated and further clinical and microbiological evaluation when MP is co-detected.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to delineate the age-related clinical features of human metapneumovirus (hMPV)-associated lower respiratory tract infection (LRTI) and identify factors associated with severe pneumonia. A retrospective analysis of children aged 0 to 6 years revealed that atelectasis, underlying disease, consolidation, fever, wheezing, and co-detection of Mycoplasma pneumoniae were linked to higher odds of severe pneumonia. The frequency of MP co-detection increased with age, and it was associated with higher odds of severe pneumonia after multivariable adjustment. The study highlights the importance of age-specific clinical assessment, particularly focusing on respiratory status in young infants and chest imaging in older children. However, the overall age-group term did not reach statistical significance, indicating potential limitations in the generalizability of the findings. The results may inform targeted clinical practices and further research into hMPV and its interactions with other pathogens.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 人偏肺病毒(hMPV)是儿童下呼吸道感染(LRTI)的主要病因,但其在全年龄段儿童中的年龄分层分析以及病原体共检与疾病严重程度之间的关联仍不完全明确。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项回顾性研究发现,0至6岁儿童中,肺不张(22.4%)、单侧受累(65.7%)和重症肺炎(31.0%)的比例最高。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究采用主要模型分析临床特征与重症肺炎之间的关联,纳入的因素包括肺不张、基础疾病、肺实变、发热、喘息、人肺炎支原体(MP)共检、绝对中性粒细胞计数以及C反应蛋白水平。
elements_zh.main_results: 在主要模型中,肺不张(调整比值比[aOR] = 47.52)、基础疾病(9.49)、肺实变(6.82)、发热(3.29)、喘息(2.50)、人肺炎支原体(MP)共检(1.90)、绝对中性粒细胞计数较高(1.47每5 × 109/L)以及C反应蛋白水平较高(1.14每10 mg/L)均与更高的发生率相关;而绝对单核细胞计数较高(0.71每1 × 109/L)和细菌共检(0.60)则与更低的发生率相关。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 人肺炎支原体(MP)共检在较大儿童中更为常见,并且在多变量调整后与重症肺炎的发生率增加相关。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能有助于指导年龄特异性临床评估,特别关注婴幼儿的呼吸状况,以及在学龄儿童中,当临床需要时进行入院前胸部影像学检查,并在检测到MP共检时进行进一步的临床和微生物学评估。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 总体年龄组的术语未达到统计学显著性。

papers.abstract_zh: 人偏肺病毒(hMPV)是儿童下呼吸道感染(LRTI)的主要病因,但其在全年龄段儿童中的年龄分层分析以及病原体共检与疾病严重程度之间的关联仍不完全明确。本研究旨在明确hMPV-LRTI的年龄相关临床特征,并识别与重症肺炎相关的因素。这项回顾性研究发现,0至6岁儿童中,肺不张(22.4%)、单侧受累(65.7%)和重症肺炎(31.0%)的比例最高。在主要模型中,肺不张(调整比值比[aOR] = 47.52)、基础疾病(9.49)、肺实变(6.82)、发热(3.29)、喘息(2.50)、人肺炎支原体(MP)共检(1.90)、绝对中性粒细胞计数较高(1.47每5 × 109/L)以及C反应蛋白水平较高(1.14每10 mg/L)均与更高的发生率相关;而绝对单核细胞计数较高(0.71每1 × 109/L)和细菌共检(0.60)则与更低的发生率相关。较大的影像学关联可能部分反映了基于病变范围的严重程度标准。MP共检率在0至6个月的婴儿中为6.0%,而在6岁以上儿童中则增加至50.0%。总体年龄组的术语未达到统计学显著性。hMPV-LRTI的临床和影像学表现因年龄组而异。在多变量调整后,MP共检在较大儿童中更为常见,并与重症肺炎的发生率增加相关。这些发现可能有助于指导年龄特异性临床评估,特别关注婴幼儿的呼吸状况,以及在学龄儿童中,当临床需要时进行入院前胸部影像学检查,并在检测到MP共检时进行进一步的临床和微生物学评估。

papers.title: Immunoinformatics-guided design and in silico evaluation of BAFF- and APRIL-adjuvanted multi-epitope vaccine candidates against human metapneumovirus
papers.abstract: Introduction Human metapneumovirus (HMPV) is a leading cause of acute respiratory tract infections in infants, older adults, and immunocompromised individuals; however, no licensed vaccine is currently available. This study employed an immunoinformatics-guided reverse vaccinology approach to design novel BAFF- and APRIL-adjuvanted multi-epitope vaccine candidates against HMPV. Methods Major structural and non-structural HMPV proteins, including fusion (F), attachment glycoprotein (G), (matrix) M2-1, M2-2, phosphoprotein (P), nucleoprotein (N), small hydrophobic (SH), and RNA-dependent RNA polymerase (L) proteins, were screened for antigenicity. Cytotoxic T lymphocyte (CTL), helper T lymphocyte (HTL), B-cell, and interferon-γ (IFN-γ)-inducing epitopes were predicted and evaluated for antigenicity, allergenicity, toxicity, and immunogenicity before being assembled into multi-epitope constructs using appropriate peptide linkers. BAFF and APRIL were incorporated as candidate immunomodulatory components based on their established roles in B-cell biology and humoral immune responses. Results The final vaccine constructs contained 24 selected epitopes (8 CTL, 8 HTL, and 8 B-cell epitopes) and demonstrated favorable predicted antigenicity, stability, hydrophilicity, thermostability, and non-allergenic and non-toxic properties. Secondary structure analysis revealed balanced proportions of α-helices, β-strands, and random coils, supporting structural stability and epitope accessibility. Molecular docking predicted putative interactions between the vaccine constructs and Toll-like receptors TLR1 and TLR4, with the predicted complexes exhibiting multiple intermolecular contacts at the receptor-ligand interfaces. These findings suggest structural compatibility between the vaccine constructs and the selected TLRs; however, functional receptor binding and activation require experimental validation. Conclusion The in silico analyses identified BAFF- and APRIL-containing multi-epitope constructs with favorable predicted antigenic, physicochemical, structural, and immunological characteristics that warrant further experimental investigation. These computational findings provide a basis for prioritizing candidate constructs. Nevertheless, molecular dynamics simulations and in vitro and in vivo studies are required to validate the structural stability, immunogenicity, safety, and protective efficacy of the proposed vaccine candidates.

papers.abstract_zh: 引言 人偏肺病毒(HMPV)是婴幼儿、老年人和免疫功能低下人群急性呼吸道感染的主要病原体;然而目前尚无获批的疫苗疫苗。本研究采用基于免疫信息学的反向疫苗学方法设计新型BAFF和APRIL佐剂多表位疫苗候选疫苗以针对HMPV。方法 对主要的HMPV结构蛋白和非结构蛋白,包括融合蛋白(F)、附着糖蛋白(G)、(基质)M2-1、M2-2、磷酸蛋白(P)、核蛋白(N)、小疏水蛋白(SH)和RNA依赖性RNA聚合酶(L)蛋白进行了抗原性筛选。预测并评估了细胞毒性T淋巴细胞(CTL)、辅助T淋巴细胞(HTL)、B细胞和干扰素-γ(IFN-γ)诱导表位的抗原性、致敏性、毒性及免疫原性,随后使用适当的肽连接子将其组装成多表位结构。基于其在B细胞生物学和体液免疫中的已知作用,将BAFF和APRIL作为候选免疫调节成分纳入其中。结果 最终的疫苗结构包含24个选定的表位(8个CTL表位、8个HTL表位和8个B细胞表位),并表现出良好的预测抗原性、稳定性、亲水性、热稳定性以及非致敏性和非毒性特性。二级结构分析显示α-螺旋、β-折叠和无规卷曲的比例均衡,支持结构稳定性和表位可接近性。分子对接预测了疫苗结构与Toll样受体TLR1和TLR4之间的潜在相互作用,预测的复合物在受体-配体界面表现出多个分子间接触。这些发现表明疫苗结构与所选TLRs之间存在结构兼容性;然而,功能性受体结合和激活仍需实验验证。结论 体外分析识别出含有BAFF和APRIL的多表位结构,其预测的抗原性、物理化学特性、结构特性和免疫特性均良好,值得进一步实验研究。这些计算结果为候选结构的优先级提供了依据。然而,需要进行分子动力学模拟以及体外和体内研究,以验证所提出疫苗候选疫苗的结构稳定性、免疫原性、安全性和保护效果。

papers.title: Retrospective analysis of multiplex panel tests in the diagnosis of respiratory tract infections
papers.abstract: Respiratory tract infections (RTIs) remain a major global health concern, particularly in children. The overlapping clinical manifestations of RTIs highlight the need for rapid and accurate diagnostic methods such as multiplex PCR (mPCR). This retrospective single-center study investigated the epidemiology of respiratory pathogens detected by mPCR, focusing on their distribution, age-related patterns, seasonal variation, and coinfections. Nasopharyngeal swab samples from 328 patients with suspected acute RTIs, collected between January 2022 and December 2023, were analyzed using the BioFire FilmArray Respiratory Panel 2.1. Demographic characteristics, clinical findings, pathogen distribution, seasonal trends, and coinfections were evaluated. At least one respiratory pathogen was detected in 270 of 328 specimens, yielding an overall positivity rate of 82.3%. Viral pathogens predominated; human rhinovirus/enterovirus HRV/HEV (28%), adenovirus (21.8%), respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) (14.2%), and influenza viruses (11.3%) were the most frequently identified agents. Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) and human metapneumovirus (HMPV) were detected in 6.8% and 5.8% of cases, respectively. The vast majority of specimens (91.5%) were from pediatric patients (0–18 years). Coinfections were identified in 31.8% of positive cases, most commonly involving adenovirus and HRV/HEV. Seasonal analysis demonstrated a marked increase in positivity during winter and spring months, accounting for 74% of all positive cases. Bacterial pathogens were rarely detected. mPCR demonstrated high diagnostic value, with pathogens detected in 82.3% of samples, predominantly viral agents. These findings support the role of mPCR in improving diagnostic accuracy and providing valuable regional epidemiological data. Rapid identification of viral pathogens may also support antimicrobial stewardship by facilitating more informed clinical decision-making; however, antibiotic utilization was not evaluated in the present study.

papers.abstract_zh: 呼吸道感染(RTIs)仍然是全球主要的健康问题,尤其是在儿童中。RTIs的重叠临床表现凸显了需要快速准确的诊断方法,如多重PCR(mPCR)。本回顾性单中心研究调查了mPCR检测到的呼吸道病原体的种类,重点关注其分布、年龄相关模式、季节性变化和混合感染。使用BioFire FilmArray Respiratory Panel 2.1对2022年1月至2023年12月期间收集的328例疑似急性RTI患者的鼻咽拭子样本进行了分析。评估了人口统计学特征、临床发现、病原体分布、季节趋势和混合感染情况。在328份样本中,至少检测到一种呼吸道病原体的有270份,总体阳性率为82.3%。病毒性病原体占主导地位;人类鼻病毒/肠病毒HRV/HEV(28%)、腺病毒(21.8%)、呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)(14.2%)和流感病毒(11.3%)是最常见的病原体。严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2(SARS-CoV-2)和人偏肺病毒(HMPV)分别在6.8%和5.8%的病例中被检测到。绝大多数样本(91.5%)来自0-18岁儿童。在阳性病例中,有31.8%出现了混合感染,最常见的混合感染涉及腺病毒和HRV/HEV。季节性分析显示,在冬季和春季的阳性率显著增加,占所有阳性病例的74%。细菌性病原体很少被检测到。mPCR表现出高诊断价值,检测到病原体的样本占82.3%,主要为病毒性病原体。这些发现支持了mPCR在提高诊断准确性并提供有价值的区域流行病学数据中的作用。快速识别病毒性病原体可能也有助于抗菌药物的合理使用,通过促进更明智的临床决策;然而,本研究中并未评估抗生素的使用情况。

papers.title: Post-pandemic re-establishment of respiratory virus seasonality and molecular epidemiology of Rhinovirus/Enterovirus in Northern Italy: a three-year surveillance study (2023-2026).
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVES: Following the COVID-19 pandemic, respiratory virus circulation progressively returned towards patterns observed in the pre-pandemic period. However, long-term epidemiological data describing the re-establishment of respiratory viral seasonality and the molecular diversity of Rhinovirus/Enterovirus (RV/EV) remain limited. METHODS: To investigate the circulation patterns of respiratory viruses and characterize the RV/EV in Northern Italy, a retrospective observational study was conducted on samples collected between April 2023 and April 2026 at Brescia Civic Hospital. Respiratory viruses were detected by real-time PCR, and RV/EV-positive samples were characterized through next-generation sequencing. RESULTS: A total of 6,919 respiratory virus-positive samples were identified. SARS-CoV-2 remained the most frequently detected pathogen, followed by RV/EV, influenza A/B (FLU A/B), adenovirus, respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), parainfluenza virus, bocavirus, and human metapneumovirus. Distinct seasonal peaks were observed for FLU A/B and RSV during winter months, whereas RV/EV circulated continuously throughout the year. Molecular characterization of 224 RV/EV-positive samples revealed substantial genetic diversity. Pediatric patients accounted for the majority of sequenced cases. CONCLUSIONS: Three years after the end of the COVID-19 pandemic, respiratory viruses have re-established their characteristic seasonal circulation patterns. Nevertheless, RV/EV remain the dominant non-influenza respiratory pathogens and display considerable genetic heterogeneity. Continuous molecular surveillance is essential for early detection of emerging respiratory viral threats.

news.content: 投稿 ログイン 会員登録 SYSTEM NOTICE Auto translation by AI. Be sure, accuracy, nuances and authorial intent may not be fully reflected. Show original My son, who back then was like, 'It's just bananas and rice!', and where he is now. 5 さちゃん 2026年9月21日 20:59 Last week, our whole family caught the human metapneumovirus. And, remarkably, we all got it at the same time. Adults and children alike fell ill, and everyone in the house was just staggering around. "Is there anyone here who's feeling okay!?" ......Nope. 😂 Of course, my son also had a very high fever, and it was a tough few days. But even in the midst of that, his appetite was voracious. That was the one thing I felt a little relieved about. Watching my son gobble up his favorite rolled omelet, I suddenly remembered him when he was eight months old. Back then, my son had so many allergies. ⸻ The day we found out about the allergies We found out about them when he was eight months old. Dogs, cats, wheat, gluten, dairy products, eggs, soy, and house dust. ......That's a lot. Haha Until then, my son's skin had always been prone to irritation. Our regular pediatrician told us it was just "sensitive skin," and I thought that was just how it was. Then one day, a cat's claw scratched my son's arm, and he bled a little. Right after that, my son threw up. "......Wait, could this be something not normal?" Thinking that, I decided to see a pediatrician who specialized in allergies. And that's where we found out about all those allergies. "I should have gone to a different hospital sooner," I thought, blaming myself. But now that we knew, we had to do something about it. ⸻ First, fix the skin In my son's case, it started with improving the condition of his skin. Moisturizer and steroids twice a day. The doctor taught me to "apply the moisturizer by placing it on the body." So, I would pile plenty of moisturizer on my son's body and diligently rub it in. Morning and night, I applied it diligently every day. Naturally, this meant my clothes were also covered in moisturizer 😂 And it wasn't just that it was sticky. My black clothes would turn white. "My clothes are white again today..." Thinking that while I applied it is now a fond memory. Haha ⸻ "It's just bananas and rice!" And another thing that was tough was baby food. Eggs, dairy, wheat, soy... The baby food I had been buying without a second thought was completely unusable. I would pick up baby food at the store and stare intently at the ingredient list. "This has eggs... no good." "This has dairy... no good." "This one has wheat... no good." By the time I was done, I was in a state of, "It's just bananas and rice!" 😂 Baby food is already hard enough, with worries like, "What should I make today... it takes so long to make... what should I feed him..." Adding allergies to that made it quite a challenge. I sometimes thought about how parents raising children with even more severe allergies must be even more stressed out about their daily meals... ⸻ 1g at a time, little by little While looking for things he could eat, we also gradually increased the amount of allergenic foods he could consume. I measured ingredients in 1g increments, little by little. "He was able to eat 1g today!" Even if I was happy about that, sometimes he would have a reaction the next time he ate it. Just because he could eat 1g didn't mean, "Great! He's fine now!" It didn't work like that. Steadily, cautiously, little by little. We had emergency medication, and sometimes we could lighten the reaction when symptoms appeared. So we were lucky, but I think parents raising children with severe allergies who have to use an EpiPen must have it really tough. That's how we gradually increased the things he could eat. ⸻ And now It wasn't like he could eat everything right away. One by one, little by little. "Is he okay today?" "How about this time?" We proceeded while checking. And now. Believe it or not, my son's allergies have all been cleared. Back then, I was at my wit's end, thinking, "It's just bananas and rice!" Now, he eats everything. Haha Especially eggs, which he had a very strong reaction to at the time. Now... Is he a Dyson vacuum cleaner? That's the intensity with which he eats rolled omelets. Haha I want to tell my past self: "It's okay. Before long, this kid will be sucking up rolled omelets like a Dyson." ⸻ And our cat Another thing I was worried about was our cat. When we found out about the cat allergy, I thought, "Oh no, the cat... what should I do?" But the doctor told me, "The cat is family, too. You just need to learn how to live together well." I was saved by those words, and the life of the cat and my son continued. Now, the cat comes to check on my son if he cries, and they play together. Of course, when he's not feeling well, I sometimes stop him, saying, "Let's not pet the cat today." But all in all, they live together happily. Back then, when we found out about so many allergies, I wondered, "What's going to happen from here on?" Now, he eats everything and lives with the cat. Show original My son, who back then was like, 'It's just bananas and rice!', and where he is now. 5 さちゃん 2026年9月21日 20:59 Last week, our whole family caught the human metapneumovirus. And, remarkably, we all got it at the same time. Adults and children alike fell ill, and everyone in the house was just staggering around. "Is there anyone here who's feeling okay!?" ......Nope. 😂 Of course, my son also had a very high fever, and it was a tough few days. But even in the midst of that, his appetite was voracious. That was the one thing I felt a little relieved about. Watching my son gobble up his favorite rolled omelet, I suddenly remembered him when he was eight months old. Back then, my son had so many allergies. ⸻ The day we found out about the allergies We found out about them when he was eight months old. Dogs, cats, wheat, gluten, dairy products, eggs, soy, and house dust. ......That's a lot. Haha Until then, my son's skin had always been prone to irritation. Our regular pediatrician told us it was just "sensitive skin," and I thought that was just how it was. Then one day, a cat's claw scratched my son's arm, and he bled a little. Right after that, my son threw up. "......Wait, could this be something not normal?" Thinking that, I decided to see a pediatrician who specialized in allergies. And that's where we found out about all those allergies. "I should have gone to a different hospital sooner," I thought, blaming myself. But now that we knew, we had to do something about it. ⸻ First, fix the skin In my son's case, it started with improving the condition of his skin. Moisturizer and steroids twice a day. The doctor taught me to "apply the moisturizer by placing it on the body." So, I would pile plenty of moisturizer on my son's body and diligently rub it in. Morning and night, I applied it diligently every day. Naturally, this meant my clothes were also covered in moisturizer 😂 And it wasn't just that it was sticky. My black clothes would turn white. "My clothes are white again today..." Thinking that while I applied it is now a fond memory. Haha ⸻ "It's just bananas and rice!" And another thing that was tough was baby food. Eggs, dairy, wheat, soy... The baby food I had been buying without a second thought was completely unusable. I would pick up baby food at the store and stare intently at the ingredient list. "This has eggs... no good." "This has dairy... no good." "This one has wheat... no good." By the time I was done, I was in a state of, "It's just bananas and rice!" 😂 Baby food is already hard enough, with worries like, "What should I make today... it takes so long to make... what should I feed him..." Adding allergies to that made it quite a challenge. I sometimes thought about how parents raising children with even more severe allergies must be even more stressed out about their daily meals... ⸻ 1g at a time, little by little While looking for things he could eat, we also gradually increased the amount of allergenic foods he could consume. I measured ingredients in 1g increments, little by little. "He was able to eat 1g today!" Even if I was happy about that, sometimes he would have a reaction the next time he ate it. Just because he could eat 1g didn't mean, "Great! He's fine now!" It didn't work like that. Steadily, cautiously, little by little. We had emergency medication, and sometimes we could lighten the reaction when symptoms appeared. So we were lucky, but I think parents raising children with severe allergies who have to use an EpiPen must have it really tough. That's how we gradually increased the things he could eat. ⸻ And now It wasn't like he could eat everything right away. One by one, little by little. "Is he okay today?" "How about this time?" We proceeded while checking. And now. Believe it or not, my son's allergies have all been cleared. Back then, I was at my wit's end, thinking, "It's just bananas and rice!" Now, he eats everything. Haha Especially eggs, which he had a very strong reaction to at the time. Now... Is he a Dyson vacuum cleaner? That's the intensity with which he eats rolled omelets. Haha I want to tell my past self: "It's okay. Before long, this kid will be sucking up rolled omelets like a Dyson." ⸻ And our cat Another thing I was worried about was our cat. When we found out about the cat allergy, I thought, "Oh no, the cat... what should I do?" But the doctor told me, "The cat is family, too. You just need to learn how to live together well." I was saved by those words, and the life of the cat and my son continued. Now, the cat comes to check on my son if he cries, and they play together. Of course, when he's not feeling well, I sometimes stop him, saying, "Let's not pet the cat today." But all in all, they live together happily. Back then, when we found out about so many allergies, I wondered, "What's going to happen from here on?" Now, he eats everything and lives with the cat.
